title: tests.yml's macOS job pins macos-15: on 4 Nov macos-latest gave 1.4.3's candidate no runner, which stopped the cut
body:
## What

On 4 Nov 2026 the 1.4.3 cut stopped at its candidate's CI. Run 41898191402, the push of `candidate/v1.4.3` at 4e0714a, passed Test on Ubuntu and Shell Script Analysis. Its Test on macOS job (126813241516) asked for `macos-latest` and was never given a runner: it has no runner name and no steps, and GitHub cancelled it after 15 minutes (19:34:11Z to 19:49:14Z) with "The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts", beside the notice "Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience longer queue times." A candidate requires the macOS leg, so Test Summary failed the run, and the cut stopped before it tagged.

Pplr's `macos-latest` jobs were stranded the same way twice that day while Cldr's and Ccusage's `macos-15` jobs got runners, and Pplr pinned `macos-15` (Pplr 8a1760f). hv's ruling (b), relayed by molt-vc on 4 Nov: Molt's `test-macos` pins `macos-15` too.

## What Molt's macOS job has run on

Measured on 5 Nov from GitHub's API, over all 333 `tests.yml` runs from 12 Mar to 4 Nov 2026: every one of their macOS jobs asked for `macos-latest`, so none has asked for `macos-15`. 91 got a runner, 79 of them passing (12 Mar to v1.4.2's run on 4 Nov) and 12 failing (23 Mar to 15 Sep). The job's `if:` skipped 240. 2 were cancelled before any runner took them: a dispatch on main on 15 Oct (run 38747778274) and 1.4.3's candidate on 4 Nov.

GitHub still keeps the logs of the 73 macOS jobs from 18 Aug to 4 Nov, and every one names `macos-26-arm64` as its image, across image versions 20260728.0273.1 to 20261026.0455.2, from v1.1.0's run on 26 Oct to v1.4.2's on 4 Nov. v1.4.2's (run 41827929456, image version 20261026.0455.2, macOS 26.6.2) ran 644 tests, 0 failing and 1 skipped. The 18 jobs before 18 Aug, from 12 Mar to 25 Jun, have no log left: GitHub answers 410 for June's 7 and keeps no step record for March's and April's 11, so their image cannot be read. They asked for `macos-latest` like the rest, so whether any of them landed on `macos-15` through that label is not known. What is measured is that no Molt job had asked for `macos-15` before this change.

## The change

- `.github/workflows/tests.yml`: `test-macos` runs on `macos-15`, where it ran on `macos-latest`. The Linux jobs stay on `ubuntu-latest`, and `pr-checks.yml` has no macOS job.
- `.github/workflows/README.md`: the job table's runner for `test-macos`.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: a new `[1.4.4] - unreleased` section. It opens by saying Homebrew goes from 1.4.2 to 1.4.4, because 1.4.3's cut stopped before its tag and devbin never re-dates a dated note. Its Changed carries this line.

`macos-15` is an arm64 image as well, so the pin does not take Molt out of a squeeze on arm64 capacity. What it changes is the pool: on 4 Nov the `macos-15` pool served Cldr's and Ccusage's jobs while the `macos-latest` pool served neither Pplr's nor Molt's. It also stops Molt's macOS changing whenever GitHub moves the label, so Molt tests on the macOS that Pplr, Cldr and Ccusage test on.

## Not this issue

- molt-vc's two notes on 0088, `tests.yml:161`'s 142-column comment and the `MOLT_CCUSAGE` directory seam, stay as hv left them.

## As built (dc, 5 Nov 2026)

- molt-vc merged `dc/0092-macos-15` at b0e9a0c, one commit on fe69ea4, as 6b65275 on 5 Nov, its gate green. molt-vc's review: the three files and nothing else, `tests.yml:90` and the README row read `macos-15` with the table aligned, and `## [1.4.4] - unreleased` sits above [1.4.3] in the shape devbin's notes check parses, with nothing added under [1.4.3].
- Proof: actionlint 1.7.12 finds nothing on `tests.yml`, on main and on the branch, and again on the branch's `tests.yml` and `pr-checks.yml` in molt-vc's review. No bats run: no test reads the workflow files or CHANGELOG.md.
- The release is v1.4.4, not a resumed v1.4.3. On 5 Nov molt-vc's dry run of v1.4.3 failed at devbin 0.1.19's notes check, which takes a note only while it is unreleased or dated today, and 1.4.3's is dated 4 Nov. 4e0714a stays (hv: "I am not going backwards here").

## The first macos-15 run (dc, 5 Nov 2026)

hv cut v1.4.4 on 5 Nov: release commit bc96429, tag 949fa42 on both remotes. Its candidate's run, 41972555495 (`candidate/v1.4.4` at bc96429), is the first Molt run to ask for `macos-15`, and it is green. Read from its job logs by dc, matching what molt-vc read:

- Test on macOS (job 127063904229): label `macos-15`, runner GitHub Actions 1000009815, image `macos-15-arm64` version 20261028.0489.1, macOS 15.8.2 (24H232), 05:12:44Z to 05:22:44Z. 648 of 648 ok, 0 not ok, 1 skipped. The skip is test 166, issue 0069's `molt doctor` test, "no timeout command", the same single skip as v1.4.2's leg on `macos-26-arm64`.
- Test on Ubuntu (job 127063904294): image `ubuntu-26.04`, 648 of 648 ok, 0 not ok, 34 skipped.
- Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary passed, and the cut read the run and tagged.

This edit also corrects v1.4.2's image version above. The note at 5e40d28 gave it as 20261021.618, which is the version of the log's Runner Image Provisioner, the first `Version:` line in every job log, not the image's.
